Happens second and third sundays of the month.

Call between 6 - 10 AM to verify that there are donations to pick up. Items will be available MTWRF 8 - 10 AM. If no one calls or comes before 10 AM, the donations will be discarded. Sam is the manager.
Pick up at any time of the day. Usually about 2 bags of cookies, already bagged.
(206) 794 3915 for Lawrence, check in before noon and pickup is between noon and 5 and needs 2-3 people preferably. Prioritize freedges.
Arrive around 1:45 for pick up. Can call before to check how much there will be as it can be a heavy pickup.
MJ (if no one can get to it)

Bring plastic/liquid proof bags/boxes to pick up. Their boxes of liquidy food are pretty flimsy and so are the bags they give you for them. Definitely easy to have food drop through before you even leave campus. They usually give 1-2 bags of food boxes and sometimes pizza.
Small pickup. Make sure to return the boxes they give us.
Not ready until 8:45 at the earliest. They close right at 9 if not a few minutes before. Can be a heavy pickup, with a full bag of loaves and a pizza or two.
Arrive around 9pm and the employees know the drill. Food given in boxes in plastic bags, so any liquid spillage is contained in the bag. Usually not more than 2 bags.

Bring a container or boxes (with a container to hold them) to pack rice. Take a rice cooker at a time from the kitchen and pack in the inside dining area. Usually pretty heavy, so bring a friend or wheels.

Pick up 10-15 minutes before they close. If you can, save and wash the containers for the next pickup. It can be a heavy pickup, with several large containers of rice, liquidy meat, and/or a big bag of chips. Call ahead if size matters. Box food within food safety guidelines & bring to freedges.
